text:
Sophie Chen: FjordAI just pinged us about listing fjord-14b (open license) in the marketplace + a joint SI integration with Accord Systems. They want a firm launch week in 3 weeks. Need alignment on redistribution rights, geofence options, and what artifacts we need from them.

Marcus Lee: Quick legal note: open license can still have 'no-rehost' or 'no-commercial' caveats. Ask them to confirm exact SPDX / license text. Also need clarity if we can distribute any converted/quantized artifacts to customers.

Priya Nair: For Marketplace listing we need: model-card, checksum, container manifest, and a minimal perf report. If we plan to offer Dedicated/Private SKUs, note KMS integration + HSM support can add 2-3 days to onboarding.

Tom O'Neil: Sales wants region-tied SKUs. If Accord Systems needs EU-only hosting for some customers, we should prepare geofenced SKUs and pricing. Also: co-sell carve? We should confirm announcement co-op budget.

Sophie Chen: Good points. Accord asked whether we can host raw weights or only provide hosted inference. They also asked if we can distribute quantized weights to SI for offline deployments.

Marcus Lee: If they permit distribution of quantized weights, add "Derived Artifacts Distribution" clause that explicitly allows our engineers and SI partners to convert and redistribute quantized variants under the same license. Also require provenance headers in artifacts.

acc-bot: Automated checklist lookup: Found precedent: "Derived Artifacts Addendum v1" and "Geofence Hosting Schedule". Links sent to channel (placeholder).

Priya Nair: Tech checklist for eng-platform / eng-ml:
```
- model_id: fjord-14b
- artifacts: fp16 weights, model-card.md, tokenizer.json, sample-inputs.tar.gz
- container: oci image + sha256
- optional: q4_0/q8_0 artifacts (if provided)
- CI: preload + smoke test (inference < 500ms @ 1 token/min config)
- security: artifact-signature & provenance.json
```
If FjordAI cannot provide q4 artifacts, Eng-ML can run conversions but need distribution rights.

Tom O'Neil: Also FYI Accord wants co-announcement but only after SI validation. They requested a 7-day embargo post-validation. That pushes our launch window to ~4 weeks. Is that acceptable?

Sophie Chen: We can accommodate 4 weeks, but request a 72hr soft-lock once embargo date set. Need partner marketing assets (logo, quotes, social copy) 5 days before embargo.

Marcus Lee: Actionables for legal: I will draft a limited-scope addendum for Derived Artifacts + Geoblocking and circulate by EOD tomorrow. Need FjordAI license text to proceed.

Priya Nair: I'll prepare the Marketplace ingest template and preliminary SKU mapping (Hosted / Dedicated / Private (EU-only)). Will post draft by tomorrow morning.

Tom O'Neil: I'll draft a high-level co-sell / revenue split note and sync with Accord on announcement budget.

Sophie Chen: Great. Meeting to sync: tomorrow 10am PT. Please flag any blockers here. If FjordAI can't grant derived-artifact distribution, we need to decide whether to delay SI integrations or provide only hosted inference.

Priya Nair: ack. Will include fallback flow (hosted-only + SI integration using API) in the SKU doc.

Marcus Lee: ack. Loop me in on any license PDFs.

Sophie Chen: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
